# s298 — Keep the relay-run ledger in the git common dir so it outlives worktrees

In a git repo, `relay-run` writes and reads one ledger per repo under the git common dir, shared by every worktree, so removing a slice worktree no longer deletes its runs.

**Findings:** nested-relay trial idea0, 2026-10-15, defect 4: S16 ledger lost with worktree remove · **Size:** M · **Tree:** slicer

**2026-10-16** — Verified outcome. In a git repo relay-run now keeps one ledger per repo at <git common dir>/slicer/relay-runs.jsonl with relay-runs.lock beside it (flock in ops.ledger_lock), shared by every worktree; begin/step/end work from any worktree and unknown_run names the ledger path. Outside git, or for a project below the worktree root, the ledger stays .slicer/relay-runs.jsonl. list_runs reads the common ledger plus the legacy .slicer/relay-runs.jsonl of this checkout and each sibling worktree (damaged legacy skipped, damaged common = corrupt, a run in two files listed once). vcs.git_common_dir is now public. Docs, CLI description and CHANGELOG updated.

Tests: 63 in test_relay_run, full suite 2208 OK (1 skipped); slicer check passes. No-git fixtures now use support.isolated_discovery.

Mutations (each red for the right reason): common path always legacy; no legacy read; no dedup; no common lock (ConcurrentAppends); no at_worktree_root (ProjectBelowWorktreeRoot); no-git path moved (NoGit); _open_run legacy-only (Step_FromAnotherWorktree); gitignore always edited (Begin_InLinkedWorktree); damaged common skipped (CommonLedgerDamaged); unknown_run message path (Step_UnknownRun_NamesCommonLedger). The at_worktree_root mutation was re-proved on a scratch copy: the real .git/slicer/relay-runs.jsonl stayed 150 lines, sha256 9f206c39...7ffa1, before and after.

Hand test (scratch repo, worktrees wa and wb): begin in wa -> run-20261016-033728-7c01; step from wb -> 1; list from main -> "run-20261016-033728-7c01  active  items s1  wt wa  1 step, 1 running, 0 subagents" with step "1  implementer  Claude Code  sonnet  high  start  from wb"; end from main -> "ended run-20261016-033728-7c01 pass"; after git worktree remove wa, list from wb still shows the run as ended pass. Ledger files lived in main/.git/slicer; wb/.slicer had no ledger; git status in wb clean.

Upgrade edge, not fixed: a run that exists only in an old per-worktree .slicer/relay-runs.jsonl lists but cannot take step or end (unknown_run naming the common ledger path, exit 2). Documented in docs/commands.md and CHANGELOG; begin a new run.

trust: unverified; by: Jon Robbins

**Not in this slice:**
- A shared ledger for a project below the worktree root.
- Moving or deleting existing `.slicer/relay-runs.jsonl` files; they are only read.
- The TUI board layout (s294) and the heartbeat task rule (its own item).

## Why

The idea0 nested-relay trial on 2026-10-15 (defect 4): `.slicer/relay-runs.jsonl` lives in the slice worktree, where `relay-run begin` is told to run. After `git worktree remove`, `relay-run list` on main printed "no relay runs", so the S16 run was lost; the S03 run survived only because the outer session saved `relay-run list --json` first. The trial prompt now carries that save as a workaround. The owner chose on 2026-10-15 to keep the ledger under the git common dir.

## Files

- `src/slicer/relayrun.py`:
  - `ledger_path(root)`: when `root` is a git worktree root, `<git common dir>/slicer/relay-runs.jsonl`, with the `slicer/` directory created on first append. Otherwise (no git, or a project below the worktree root) `.slicer/relay-runs.jsonl` as today. Reuse `vcs._git_common_dir` (expose it as a public helper) and `vcs.at_worktree_root`.
  - `append`: no `.slicer/.gitignore` edit when the ledger is in the common dir.
  - `list_runs`: read the common ledger, plus any legacy `.slicer/relay-runs.jsonl` in this checkout and in each sibling worktree, so runs recorded before the upgrade still show. A damaged legacy or sibling file is skipped as now; a damaged common ledger is `corrupt`.
- `src/slicer/ops.py`, the relay-run functions: the lock around an append is a lock file beside the common ledger (`<common>/slicer/relay-runs.lock`, flock like `store.project_lock`), because worktrees do not share `.slicer/lock`. `_open_run` looks the run up in the common ledger, so `step` and `end` work from any worktree of the repo; the `unknown_run` message names the ledger path.
- `src/slicer/cli.py`: the `relay-run` description names the ledger location.
- `ARCHITECTURE.md` (the ledger paragraph and the tree listing), `docs/commands.md` (Relay run ledger, the `relay-run` rows and the `.slicer/` listing), `docs/tui.md` (where the board reads ledgers), `docs/agents.md` (`unknown_run`, `list_runs`), `CHANGELOG.md`.
- `tests/test_relay_run.py`.

## Failing tests

- `test_RelayRun_Begin_InLinkedWorktree_WritesCommonLedger`: `begin` in a linked worktree appends to `<common>/slicer/relay-runs.jsonl`, and the worktree's `.slicer/` gains no ledger and no `.gitignore` change.
- `test_RelayRun_List_SurvivesWorktreeRemove`: begin in a linked worktree, `git worktree remove` it, then `list` in the main checkout returns the run.
- `test_RelayRun_Step_FromAnotherWorktree_ExtendsRun`: a run begun in one worktree takes a step recorded from the main checkout.
- `test_RelayRun_List_ReadsLegacyWorktreeLedger`: a run in an old `.slicer/relay-runs.jsonl` still lists, once.
- `test_RelayRun_NoGit_KeepsSlicerLedger`: outside git the ledger stays `.slicer/relay-runs.jsonl`.
- `test_RelayRun_ConcurrentAppends_FromTwoWorktrees_KeepEveryLine`: two worktrees appending under the common lock leave every event readable.
